execution.target_project_description: Health Check de Integracoes & Dashboard Super Admin (NFR-I5) — Story 14-4. Backend apps/api (modules/admin/health/): GET /api/v1/admin/health/integrations roda probes em Resend (GET /domains ou dry-run), Keycloak (.well-known/openid-configuration), MinIO (HEAD/health), Redis (PING), PostgreSQL (SELECT 1), medindo latencia; classificacao healthy<1s/degraded 1-5s/unhealthy>5s-ou-erro; retorna {name,status,latencyMs,lastChecked,message?} + summary{total,healthy,degraded,unhealthy}; guard @Roles('super_admin') -> 403 p/ outros. BullMQ repeatable job a cada 5min (NAO @nestjs/schedule @Cron) com single-execution via Redis lock; persiste em tabela integration_health_log {integration_name,status,latency_ms,message,checked_at} com index (integration_name, checked_at DESC). Notificacao com debounce: so notifica se novo status persiste 2 checks consecutivos (10min, anti-flapping); emite evento system.integration.status-changed; cria notificacao p/ Super Admins via infra da Story 14.1; loga no audit com correlation_id. Frontend apps/web (/app/admin/health, Client Components): painel por integracao (nome, badge verde/amarelo/vermelho, latencia, last checked), sparkline de latencia 24h (288 pontos, SVG inline ou @nivo/line, responsivo, hover), auto-refresh 60s com 'Atualizado ha X segundos' + aviso visual stale>2min, click -> historico detalhado com erros. CRITICO: este host E producao — probes em testes/CI devem ser MOCKADOS, NUNCA bater nos servicos metanoia-prod-*. A 14-4 FORNECE a implementacao real do EmailHealthPort que a Story 14.3 deixou como StubEmailHealthPort (fechar integracao do circuit breaker do Resend). Tabela integration_health_log e platform-level/super-admin (avaliar no clarify se tem tenant_id/RLS ou e global). UUID v7 uuidv7(), Zod packages/types, TanStack Query (server state), vocabulario pastoral pt-BR.json, gate a11y (motion-safe/focus-ring). Testes: probes mock healthy/degraded/unhealthy, boundary latencia (999/1001/5001ms), flapping (max 2-3 notif), guard 403, BullMQ single-execution 2 instancias, E2E dashboard. Dependencias: 14.1 (notif infra, done), Epic 1 (Redis/Postgres). Fonte: _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/14-4-health-check-de-integracoes-dashboard-super-admin-nfr-i.md.
